title: Milestone 2 — Reactivegas on kelgroups
summary: Trace resolution, corpus exporter and compiled axiom checker have landed. Simulator C1 has integrated the accepted axiom-checker base and is completing acceptance-instrument validation before its final runs and independent audit. The bounded mutation assessment has started, and correspondence validation resumed but exposed two setup failures and a budget gap. Kelgroups still awaits delivery of an audit-contract answer. The released coordinator/browser/CLI outcome remains unfinished.

stories.next: Follow the accepted dependency sequence; close the milestone only on the released user journey.

stories.title: Reject atomically across group and app

stories.next: Verify the replacement complete brief, live argv and own START, then supervise the full independent audit through report or concrete blocker.

stories.title: Recover the same state after restart

stories.title: Separate proposing from assent

stories.title: Control a pending pledge

tracking.note: #69 is the current delivery ticket. Historical #48 work is superseded; its closure does not fulfil this remaining story.

stories.title: Keep every pledged amount solvent

stories.benefit: funds cannot be spent twice or beyond available balances

tracking.note: This story is a slice of the linked delivery work; the issue may cover other stories too.

stories.acceptance: Exercise valid spending, rejected overspending and repeated spending against the real implementation, with balances and escrow checked after each outcome.
stories.next: Implement the economic replay consumer and required refusal paths after the substrate is accepted.

stories.title: Make assenso an actual group decision
stories.want: economic permission to come from a completed vote
stories.benefit: one responsabile cannot impersonate collective assent

tracking.note: #76 explicitly carries unfinished runtime work beyond closed #54; it is not a duplicate or an open product ruling about unilateral grants.

stories.summary: Vote-derived grants and denials are already ruled. The runtime connection from closure evidence to economic authorisation is missing. Current examples can appear successful while a responsabile acts alone. Historical composition theorem #54 does not supply this executable connection.
stories.acceptance: Reachable unbacked and fabricated grants are refused; legitimate vote-derived grant/deny and the second economic consumer work through the production transition.
stories.next: Commission the executable composition without reopening the settled requirement.

stories.title: Bind assent to its exact economic effect

stories.benefit: another target, polarity or repeated use cannot borrow my assent

tracking.note: This story is a slice of the linked delivery work; the issue may cover other stories too.

stories.summary: The acceptance contract binds provenance, target, payload, polarity and one-use consumption for both economic consumers. A matching question label with caller-supplied amount is insufficient; backdonation must bind the ruled per-member share.
stories.acceptance: Demonstrate wrong-target, wrong-amount, wrong-polarity, fabricated and reused closure refusals; deliberately bypassing each binding must break its witness.
stories.next: Implement these rows as part of the composition candidate and expose them to replay.

stories.title: Close cancellation and return held funds
stories.persona: a member with an open question
stories.want: renunciation or proposer departure to close it correctly
stories.benefit: the question and any escrow are not silently stranded

tracking.note: This story is a slice of the linked delivery work; the issue may cover other stories too.

stories.summary: The ruled work closes negatively, retains the closure and records the correct cause. Continuation and refund depend on runtime composition. Deleting the question is insufficient.
stories.acceptance: Renounce and departure produce retained negative closures; the linked economic continuation refunds correctly and atomically.
stories.next: Implement the independently testable lifecycle rows, then finish continuation/refund with accepted composition.

stories.title: Recompute other questions on departure

stories.benefit: one proposer leaving does not disable legitimate decisions elsewhere

tracking.note: This story is a slice of the linked delivery work; the issue may cover other stories too.

stories.summary: The corrected acceptance requires coexistence: the departing proposer’s question closes negatively, while an unrelated threshold-crossing question may close through franchise change. The causes remain distinct.
stories.acceptance: A single departure demonstrates both closures where applicable; suppressing either closure or collapsing their causes must fail the witness.
stories.next: Keep this coexistence row in the lifecycle implementation and integrated corpus.

stories.title: Use explicitly ruled refusal semantics

tracking.note: Decision record, not a commissioned ticket. Links provide neighbouring scope only; they do not decide these questions.

stories.acceptance: Any change to these boundaries cites an explicit ruling and gains a corresponding implementation and acceptance contract.
stories.next: Keep current boundaries until a ruling is needed; resolve separately from the required lifecycle work.

stories.next: Recommend settling the supported policy before the final vote corpus and coordinator release, without treating an exhibit as a default.

tracking.note: This story is a slice of the linked delivery work; the issue may cover other stories too.

stories.title: Use the shared economic core in a browser
stories.want: the same economic rules as the coordinator
stories.benefit: my client cannot silently fork the economy

tracking.note: This story is a slice of the linked delivery work; the issue may cover other stories too.

stories.next: Constrain core dependencies for wasm from the start, then implement the browser integration under its own scope grant.

stories.title: Define client transition authority
stories.want: one explicit authority for each transition
stories.benefit: retained client computations cannot contradict the core

tracking.note: This story is a slice of the linked delivery work; the issue may cover other stories too.

stories.summary: The existing PureScript base fold is not by itself proof of duplicated economic semantics or authority to delete it. Its retained base behaviour must be reconciled with core-owned transitions, including proposer-assent changes.
stories.acceptance: Publish a core-decided/client-decided/render-only boundary and prove parity for retained base behaviour. Economic module-set equality alone does not establish that parity.
stories.next: Reconcile existing client calls and folds before changing their authority.

stories.title: Decide legacy feature inclusion explicitly

stories.title: Receive reports without pressing Enter
stories.want: worker reports to reach the desk through durable records
stories.benefit: I do not become the message transport or accidentally approve machine text

tracking.note: Standing supervision obligation. Acknowledgement and terminal-restoration defects are retained as owned tooling gaps; no separate implementation ticket has been filed.

stories.summary: Local inbox and own journal reporting remains mandatory. The kelgroups START-only wait missed a BLOCKED question; terminal preflight is now preserved and replacement waits must observe BLOCKED/COMPLETE too. Desk and quality current recovery fragments were rewritten after stale stacked projections were found; historical copies remain. General supervision/tooling defects remain owned gaps.
stories.acceptance: Reports arrive without user keystrokes; pause/recovery detection is exercised against actual delivery, and existing acknowledgements are read before waiting for new ones.
stories.next: Keep the local-only reporting boundary and read actual acknowledgements before waiting; retain the measured tooling defects for separately scoped repair.

stories.title: Account honestly for delivery effort
stories.want: effort and outcomes reported separately
stories.benefit: verification rework is not sold as delivered product value

tracking.note: Standing reporting obligation, not a product delivery ticket.

stories.summary: Three infrastructure/assurance slices have landed: trace resolution, exporter and axiom checker. Product candidates and the end-to-end coordinator remain unfinished. Invalid contracts, defective controls and supervision errors consumed substantial work; useful discoveries do not turn those costs into product features.
stories.acceptance: Keep cumulative spend and failed evidence; distinguish implementation, owner green, independent acceptance, landing and release in each report.
stories.next: Use this grouped register at every material transition; never infer completion from issue counts or a persuasive summary.

stories.title: Resume from durable evidence
stories.want: a current map and recoverable evidence
stories.benefit: I can resume without rebuilding a narrative from terminal text

stories.summary: A fetched remote root checkpoint verifies609 selected files, including current desk/quality resume projections, the corrected candidate receipt and fresh audit CI evidence. The older stacked desk instructions were preserved as historical artifacts and replaced by one current projection. Later commissioning events await the next sweep. This public recovery branch is a selected snapshot, not a full-host backup.

stories.next: Continue authorised recovery sweeps after reconciling current evidence; do not claim unverified backup completeness.

stories.benefit: changes do not disappear between the desk, tickets and diagram
